sara (People Ops): Quick question — an engineer on Team Orion asked to move their approved PTO from Jul 29–31 to Aug 9–11 because of travel changes. Problem: Jul 29–Aug 2 overlaps our customer-demo blackout and a sprint freeze. Can managers approve swaps like this, and what's the minimal coverage we should require?

mike (Eng Manager): Who's the engineer? If it's just 1 person and we can shift pairings, probably ok. Need to check on-call + demo presenters.

sara (People Ops): It's devon. He was supposed to be out Jul 29–31. He can do partial overlap, but he's on the demo dry run on Jul 30.

emily (Product PM): If devon is presenting on the dry run, we should avoid moving his PTO into that week. Can he swap specific days instead of whole block? e.g., Jul 31 + Aug 1?

mike (Eng Manager): We could do Jul 29 + Aug 1 off and have devon join the Jul 30 dry run remotely for the first hour. If he can't, we'll need someone to cover his demo slot.

jordan (People Ops): For clarity on process: managers can approve date swaps without escalation when a) team coverage remains >= 60% during the swap window, b) there is a written coverage plan posted to the team channel, and c) no person with demo responsibilities is fully absent during a dry run. Exceptions go through People Ops.

kevin (HR): Adding PTO policy notes: carryover rules aren't relevant here since this is a date swap within the same year, but FYI — annual carryover cap is 40 hours unless a documented exception is approved. Also, for swaps that create coverage gaps for customer demos, we treat those as operational exceptions (requires manager sign-off + note in HR record).

mike (Eng Manager): Proposed coverage plan (quick):
```
Jul 29: devon off (no demos) — alice covers daily stand + on-call
Jul 30: devon remote 9–10am for dry run; bob covers remainder
Jul 31: devon off — bob covers demo slot
Aug 1–2: normal
```
Posting to #eng after devon confirms.

sara (People Ops): Please paste that plan into the #eng channel and ping me once done. Managers, if you approve, respond with `approved` here so we have a trace.

mike (Eng Manager): approved :thumbsup:

devon (backend): I can do the Jul 30 remote hour and swap to Aug 9–11. I'll update my travel and put the coverage plan in #eng now. Thanks!

jordan (People Ops): Noted — I'll file a brief note on the swap (for audit) with the manager approval time. If anything changes, @sara (People Ops) will reopen.

sara (People Ops): Great — closing this thread once the #eng post exists.
